title: Player Sheet
description: Drag the mini player up and it grows into the full player: the cover flies from the bar to the hero on a slight arc, the library recedes into a card, and the sheet takes on a slow, blurred wash of the artwork. Fling it, hold it halfway, catch it mid-flight; it rubber-bands at both ends and snaps by velocity.
intent: One drag progress drives the whole morph, so the gesture can be caught, reversed and flung at any point.
